scope: Read-only public-packet reproduction review, with explicitly authorized proof-utility corrections and focused rechecks. No product edits by this audit.

findings.evidence: cache recipe SDK test unconditionally calls writeRuntimeInputs after actual emission and before optional materialization; CI runs that SDK test before native compilation and pom-runtime.xml. All nine runtime inputs are generated from packet templates.

build_candidates.py reads retained source pins and actual cache/frontend/hierarchy SDK candidate roots, compiles in a unique temporary generation, and publishes complete artifacts. It does not read an unpublished canonical checkout.

Owned build.py now uses a unique temporary source/class generation, qualified JAR publication and complete six-test-source publication. --jdk/JAVA_HOME and an optional --base-jar replace private toolchain assumptions. Final strict compile and all40 runtime contracts passed against frozen f4baf0/3f50.

module-wiring/verify.py now admits an optional --canonical-checkout; without it the canonical service is read from actual SDK candidates and reactor availability is explicitly UNAVAILABLE. No nonexistent public vendor reactor is invoked.

Native proof now compiles in a unique temporary generation and publishes completed output; optional OpenRewrite proof now uses a unique work directory. Their execution receipts remain owned by the respective integration owners.

The optional verifier consumes the local Surefire java.class.path from its actual SDK run, including pinned OpenRewrite8.17.1 artifacts. CI runs that SDK immediately before verification; archived reports are not substitute build inputs.

The default exact compiler pin remains. Explicit receipt admission binds actual patch bytes to exactly four source pins, the pinned compiler manifest and all retained templates; coexistence requires the identical receipt. Ten finite admission/refusal tests and actual frozen-receipt admission passed; original70+9 execution receipts are unchanged.

New read-only integration checker verifies128 final Java/native/descriptor sources from eight pinned active manifests plus exact upstream module descriptor custody. Primary/recovery overlaps must agree or form an explicit sealed successor edge. Actual target passed; a complete temporary source fixture with one changed comment refused at that exact file.

Initial inspection found only the M3AST Consumer uses clause and builtin Plugin provides clause missing from the local target descriptor. Root restored exact upstream custody; final target descriptor SHAae52d173 and public API SHA6a8bccb5 both pass.

qualification_limits: The normal Maven/module gates own POMs, Plugin service descriptors and their source closure.
The central registry has separate schema, fixed-point and protected-sequence qualification.
The source checker allows added unrelated files and does not promote any global receiving phase.
No full JDK, JCK or whole canonical reactor claim is made.
